old_title: Kangaroos survive Blues scare to keep AFLW record alive
new_title: Kangaroos survive Blues scare to keep AFLW record alive
old_text:
Sat, 12 Sept, 1:05 pm, Final score, Hawks 41, Bulldogs 30
Kangaroos survive Blues scare to keep AFLW record alive with 10-point win
In short:
North Melbourne is still unbeaten after a gritty 10-point victory over Carlton at Arden Street.
The Kangaroos have won a record 32 consecutive matches.
Melbourne, Richmond and Sydney also posted wins on Sunday.
